canonical_surface.height_anchor: median z of every footprint-inside FM point stored in the Phase-0 canonical NPZ
canonical_surface.plane_check: least-squares z=ax+by+c on canonical P0 fill; max absolute surface residual <=1e-9m
canonical_surface.reuse_rule: seed xyz is the exact little-endian float32 cast of the canonical Phase-0 P0 fill array; no refit or resampling

seed_contract.coordinate_frame_definition: EPSG:25832 XY minus world_offset; ellipsoidal Z local
seed_contract.rgb: mean RGB of the C001 COLMAP sparse initialization, repeated per seed
seed_contract.truth_sidechannel_rule: the three required false declarations are allowed; every other truth-geometry array or metadata key is rejected by the engine loader

boundary_propagation.candidate_rule: observed SfM+dense-init point with horizontal distance to target footprint boundary <=1.0m
boundary_propagation.target_spatial_address_rule: XY is covered by the supplied target footprint; outside-band points are retained only in rejected-count provenance
boundary_propagation.dense_multiview_rule: reproject to all locked COLMAP poses; existing PatchMatch depth agrees within max(0.50m, 0.02*camera_z) in >=2 views
boundary_propagation.aux_seed_rule: only eligible observed boundary points are emitted as a separate lineage, with XY and observed z unchanged; no point outside the target footprint and no footprint-wide extension is emitted
boundary_propagation.empty_rule: eligible count 0 emits no auxiliary seed NPZ and records zero
